name: Opskill Ecommerce
author: qqqjus

sections.description:
Opskill eCommerce is a lightweight, custom-built eCommerce solution for WordPress that allows you to manage products, invoices, variations, and payments seamlessly without relying on any other plugin. Designed for flexibility and customization, this plugin offers a tailored approach to online selling and invoicing.

Our Advantages:

  • Custom product management with variations
  • Accept more than 10 payment methods (PayPal, PayStack, Stripe, Authorize.net, Intasend, Payyed, Flutterwave ++ more)
  • Recurring payments and subscriptions
  • Full invoicing system with SMS and email reminders
  • Increase revenue with an optimized checkout page.
  • Showcase physical and digital services, product variations, custom configurations, instant downloads and more.
  • [opskill-categories columns=”4″ hide_empty=”false”] for showing categories or simply [product-categories]
  • [opskill-shop] displaying entire shop or customize to [opskill-shop style=”1″ columns=”4″]

Dependencies

  • Plugin uses PayPal rest API as payment gateway so laods paypal sdk if you have enabled PayPal. Signup with PayPal, check their terms and privacy

  • If you use intasend as payment method, you need to sign up with them here. You can refer to their terms and condition

  • If you use stripe as payment method, you need to sign up with them here. You can refer to their terms and condition

  • If you use Paystack as payment method, you need to sign up with them here. You can refer to their terms and condition

  • We handle all SMS via payyed plase sign up here for SMS package Payyed you can check SMS pricing and terms Payyed

Why this plugin?

  • Start receiving payments instantly—go from sign-up to your first real transaction in as little as 2 minutes
  • Connect your own gateways and receive payments direct
  • Modern, seamless payment experience via the modern slim, simple Checkout
  • Advanced fraud detection and prevention
  • Understand your customers better through a simple and elegant dashboard that use AI
  • Access to attentive, empathetic customer support 24/7
  • Free updates as we launch new features and payment options
  • Clearly documented APIs to build your custom payment experiences
sections.installation:
• Go to WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New from the left-hand menu
  • In the search box type Opskill eCommerce
  • Click on Install now when you see Opskill eCommerce to install the plugin
  • After installation, activate the plugin.
  • Go to products and enter products.
sections.faq:
Will WooCommerce work with my theme?

Yes! Opskill ecomemrce will work with any theme.

Where can I report bugs?

Report bugs on opskill.com. We provide free support for the plugin.

Where can I request new features?

Request new features from opskill. We regularly review requests and consider them valuable for product upgrade. Some updages we do via the main repository.
